issue.title: Additive bob ref list content measures (reading time/pages, Bottom line, code-block and link counts) for the Ref Card

task_type_fields.proposal:
Proposed by bob-cli-qp.8 (notes #13 and #14, F4 and F5 from plan:202611/ref_cards.md Follow-ups) and triaged by the bob-cli-qp land agent. The two are combined because they share one remediation path.

Add optional, additive per-reference content measures to `bob ref list -f json`, computed by bob from sources it already owns. Then let the Ref Card patch them into its existing byline and foot slots:
- F4: a reading-time or page estimate (from the PDF page count or the saved source's word count), and, for agent-report references, a "Bottom line" excerpt taken from the saved source's Bottom line section.
- F5: code-block and link counts, taken from the render-time code catalog that `bob ref code` serves (decisions:code-copy-reads-render-time-catalog) and from the saved-source Markdown. Never count by re-parsing the note or the PDF at paint time.

The card must stay passive: one shared snapshot (241a/241ak), no spawns from paint, no new rows, omit-when-absent. The fields are additive JSON with no `!`, and older bobs simply leave the slots empty. Decide each measure against the card's four questions before adding it; drop any that does not earn its pixels.
task_type_fields.why_out_of_scope: The Ref Cards plan put new bob ref list fields out of scope and stated that the card shows no code or link counts, because the card must never re-parse sources. These measures need new bob-owned JSON fields first.

issue.creation_reason: Ref Cards follow-ups F4 and F5 want richer 'what it holds' readouts, which the card can only show once bob supplies them as additive ref list fields.
